snippet.title: A corporate apology from Jazz | Ledgerbound releases August 11th!
snippet.description:
Your human resources representative, Jazz, is here on behalf of Heroes United Life Group with an important message: Ledgerbound is releasing on August 11th! Jazz's ability to gracefully take accountability is truly an aspiration for all HULG employees.

Wishlist Ledgerbound today on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3315060/Ledgerbound/
